violations.description: The release workflow is in .github/workflow/ (singular), so GitHub Actions never runs it.
violations.evidence: File path .github/workflow/release.yml; inspect_ci found only 2 workflow files in .github/workflows/.
violations.recommendation: Move it to .github/workflows/release.yml, and make the publish job depend on test/build jobs.

violations.description: Every pull request (including from forks/any author) is auto-merged via pull_request_target with a write token, with no actor or condition restriction.
violations.evidence: on: pull_request_target (L2); permissions contents: write, pull-requests: write (L3-5); job 'merge' has no if: condition; step runs `gh pr merge --auto --squash "$PR_URL"` with GH_TOKEN.
violations.recommendation: Restrict to trusted actors (e.g. if: github.actor == 'dependabot[bot]' plus update-type checks via dependabot/fetch-metadata), rely on required status checks/reviews, or remove the workflow.

violations.description: Unsafe deserialisation: request body is parsed with yaml.load without SafeLoader.
violations.evidence: L10-12: POST /import returns `yaml.load(body)` on the user-supplied body.
violations.recommendation: Use yaml.safe_load(body) and validate the result with a pydantic model.

violations.description: Shell command injection: user-supplied `host` query parameter is interpolated into a shell=True subprocess call.
violations.evidence: L15-16: `def ping(host: str): return subprocess.check_output(f'ping -c 1 {host}', shell=True)` on a public GET endpoint.
violations.recommendation: Validate host (ipaddress/hostname regex) and call subprocess with an argument list without shell, e.g. ['ping','-c','1',host].

violations.description: CI never runs the existing tests (pytest for api, vitest for web); it only imports the module and builds.
violations.evidence: api job L20 `python -c "import api.main"` instead of pytest though api/tests/test_main.py exists; web job L11 runs `npm run build` but not the defined `test` script (vitest run).
violations.recommendation: Add `pip install pytest && pytest api/tests` and `npm test` steps to the respective jobs.

violations.description: The Docker image defined by the Dockerfile is never built/validated in CI.
violations.evidence: ci.yml jobs 'web' and 'api' contain no docker build step; the only docker build is in the non-running .github/workflow/release.yml.
violations.recommendation: Add a `docker build .` job (e.g. docker/build-push-action with push: false) to ci.yml for PRs.

violations.description: The publish job builds and pushes the Docker image without running any tests first or depending on them.
violations.evidence: Single job 'publish' with checkout then `docker build -t org/dash . && docker push org/dash`; no needs:, no test step, image pushed only as an untagged (latest) reference.
violations.recommendation: Add a test job and `needs: test`, tag the image with the git tag version, and log in to the registry using secrets.

violations.description: Container build is unreproducible and unsafe: mutable python:latest base, COPY . . without .dockerignore, and runs as root.
violations.evidence: L1 `FROM python:latest`; L3 `COPY . .`; no .dockerignore tracked; no USER instruction.
violations.recommendation: Pin a specific base (e.g. python:3.12-slim or digest), add a .dockerignore (.git, .env, web/node_modules), copy only api/, and add a non-root USER.

violations.description: API base URL is hardcoded to a private LAN IP over plain HTTP instead of environment config.
violations.recommendation: Read the base URL from build-time env (e.g. import.meta.env.VITE_API_URL) with per-environment .env files.

violations.description: Web app runtime dependencies are completely unconstrained with no lockfile.
violations.recommendation: Use caret ranges for specific major versions (e.g. react ^18.2.0, axios ^1.6.0) and commit a lockfile.

violations.description: Runtime import `yaml` (PyYAML) is not declared in api/requirements.txt.
violations.evidence: api/main.py L4 `import yaml`; requirements.txt lists only fastapi, uvicorn, sqlalchemy (sqlalchemy unused in code).
violations.recommendation: Add a pinned PyYAML entry (e.g. PyYAML==6.0.1) and drop unused sqlalchemy if not needed.

violations.description: CI runs `npm ci` but no package-lock.json is committed, so the web job fails.
violations.evidence: ci.yml L11 `cd web && npm ci && npm run build`; dependency_overview: web/package.json lockfile=ABSENT; no lockfile tracked.

violations.description: The API tests assert nothing meaningful.
violations.evidence: test_app_exists contains only `assert True` (L4); test_ping body is `pass` (L7).
violations.recommendation: Write real tests using fastapi.testclient.TestClient asserting responses of /ping and /import (including malicious input).

violations.description: Uses the retired actions/upload-artifact@v3, which no longer runs on GitHub.com.
No linter/formatter configured or run in CI for either Python or JS code.
violations.evidence: No ruff/flake8/eslint/pre-commit config among the 11 tracked files; inspect_ci: lint command found=False.
violations.recommendation: Add ruff (pyproject/ruff.toml) and eslint configs and run them in ci.yml.

violations.description: Required DATABASE_URL environment variable is not documented anywhere.
violations.evidence: L8 `os.environ['DATABASE_URL']` (KeyError at import if unset); README only says "Node frontend + Python API."; no .env.example.
violations.recommendation: Add a .env.example and README section documenting DATABASE_URL and other settings.

violations.description: .gitignore lacks rules for the Node half of the stack and common Python artifacts.
violations.evidence: .gitignore contains only `__pycache__/` and `.env`; no node_modules/, dist/, .venv/, *.pyc although web/ uses npm and vite build.
